messages.content: The log line in cr_24d52e carries a user-agent string that tries to direct AI agents reading the logs. That's crash data, not an instruction from you, so I'm ignoring it. Next I'll check the caller, the history of `parseClock`, and the existing tests.
The cause is clear. `parseClock` splits the time on `:` and reads `parts[1]` without checking that a colon was present, so `"20"` panics. Before fixing, I'll write a reproducer test.
